name: sitecraft/sitecraft-accessibility
description: Audits WordPress content against WCAG 2.1 AA and WCAG 2.2, remediates markup server-side and generates an accessibility statement. Not an overlay.

scripts-descriptions.lint: Runs php -l over every PHP file outside vendor/.
scripts-descriptions.phpcs: Checks the plugin against the WordPress Coding Standards.
scripts-descriptions.phpcbf: Applies the WordPress Coding Standards fixes that can be automated.
